message.content:
This is a floor covering of plastics in rolls, so it falls in heading 3918. Heading 3918 covers plastic floor coverings, whether or not self-adhesive, in rolls or tiles. Polyurethane is not polymers of vinyl chloride, so subheading 3918.10 does not apply. The residual subheading is 3918.90 ("of other plastics"). The 10-digit statistical suffix under 3918.90 is 3918.90.10 for "of other plastics" in rolls, but I am not certain of the split. I recall 3918.90.10 as "Of addition polymerization products" (the 3918.90.1000 line), and 3918.90.90 as "Other". Polyurethane is a polyaddition product, not an addition polymerization product in the usual tariff sense, so 3918.90.1000 is not the right line. The best fit is therefore 3918.90.9000.

{"hts_code": "3918.90.9000", "reason": "Rolled polyurethane commercial flooring is a plastic floor covering of heading 3918, and because it is not vinyl chloride polymer or addition polymerization product it falls in the residual 'other plastics' subheading 3918.90.90."}
